content.title: What stores are open on Easter? Schedules for Target, Costco, Trader Joe's
content.text: Skip to content By Bay Area News GroupPUBLISHED: April 15, 2025 at 9:49 AM PDT | UPDATED: April 15, 2025 at 10:05 AM PDTGetting your Trinity Audio player ready...Easter — this year on April 20 — is a holiday for some businesses that are open most Sundays. Related Articles Jury finds that Ticketmaster and Live Nation had an anticompetitive monopoly over big concert venues Allbirds soars 461% after sneaker firm rebrands as AI stock 7-Eleven plans to shutter more than 600 North American stores Ben & Jerry’s co-founder wants the company to be independent once more Beloved Walnut Creek sports bar finds new home in vintage downtown building Here’s the status for some retail chains with stores in the Bay Area: Target: closed. All stores nationwide will be shut for Easter. Costco: closed. All stores will be closed; Easter is one of the chain’s seven annual holidays. Trader Joe’s: open. Regular Sunday hours will be in effect. Safeway: open. Whole Foods: open. Home Depot: open 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. Keep WatchingToday in History: April 16, nearly 600 killed after cargo ships explode in Texas harborRead More Starbucks: A corporate spokesman said holiday closures vary by location and advised checking the company’s app for a specific store’s hours.
